  a) Determine the record line.
  b) Send the record line to the CCU.

2) Come on, ride!
  a) Have a blast while riding safely.

  a) Using Y-TRAC, download the log recorded in the CCU.
  b) Acquired data will be displayed in a list view. Tapping the data icon displays the graph.
